description: Spread Merge: takes eight monophonic gate and CV pairs and deals each one round a block of polyphonic channels, so a new note lands on a free channel while the previous one finishes releasing

params.text: Cycles how the CV output is sampled: S&H takes the CV as the gate beside it goes high and holds it, T&H follows that CV for as long as the gate stays high
Sets how many output channels each patched input pair gets: Max divides 16 between the patched pairs, or 2 to 8 fixes the block size; the lamp below glows red when the blocks exceed 16 channels

inputs.text: One of the eight CV inputs, sampled onto the channel its gate is using; a CV with no gate patched beside it is left out
One of the eight gate inputs, reading high above 2V and low below 0.2V; each rising edge moves on to the next channel of that input's block

outputs.text: Carries the sampled CV of each input on the same channel its gate went to
Carries each input's gates spread round that input's block of channels, 10V high and 0V low

notes: an input pair is counted as used if any gate below it is patched, so leaving a gap in the gate column spends that pair's block of channels on nothing
both outputs go to no channels at all while the blocks do not fit within 16 channels, and the red lamp is the only sign of it
place a Spread Merge Expander immediately to the right for another eight CV inputs and another CV output; there is no limit on how many follow
the gate and CV inputs are monophonic; the two outputs are polyphonic
menu: Add CV Expander — places a Spread Merge Expander immediately to the right
